annotations.title: Get Statuses of All Teams at an Event

description: Retrieve every team's status at an event in one call, returned as an object keyed by team key. Each entry mirrors get_team_event_status (qualification rank and record, alliance and pick, playoff progression, pit location, summary strings, next/last match key) or is null for a team without status. Use for event-wide dashboards instead of calling get_team_event_status per team.

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.
